  • Advice and care instructions

    IKEA 365+ Lid303.930.63

The food container is made of oven-safe glass and can be used as an oven/serving dish.

The snap-and-lock lid prevents leakage and creates an aroma tight seal, making it ideal for both transporting and storing food.

The container is made of glass, which does not absorb odours or discolour from tomato sauce, etc, so the food container is easy to clean.

The container and the lid are both transparent, so it’s easy to find what you are looking for, regardless of where the jar is placed.

Designer

Sarah Fager
